# `timescale-mismatch`: Design units use inconsistent or missing time scales / 设计单元的时间尺度不一致或缺失

**Severity / 严重程度:** `warning`

## English

### Cause

Some design units declare time units and precision while another unit in the same compilation omits or differs from that timing policy.

### Risk

Delay literals can represent different real durations across hierarchy, producing simulation behavior that depends on file and tool configuration.

### Fix

Declare one consistent timeunit and timeprecision or timescale policy for every compiled design unit.

## 简体中文

### 原因

部分设计单元声明了时间单位和精度，而同一编译中的其他单元遗漏或采用了不同的时序策略。

### 风险

延时字面量在不同层次中可能代表不同真实时长，使仿真行为依赖文件和工具配置。

### 修复

为所有参与编译的设计单元声明一致的 timeunit、timeprecision 或 timescale 策略。

## Failing example / 问题示例

```systemverilog
`timescale 1ns/1ps
module timed_child(input logic data_i, output logic data_o);
  assign #1 data_o = data_i;
endmodule

`resetall
module timescale_mismatch(input logic data_i, output logic data_o);
  timed_child child (.data_i(data_i), .data_o(data_o));
endmodule
```

## Fixed example / 修复示例

```systemverilog
`timescale 1ns/1ps
module timed_child(input logic data_i, output logic data_o);
  assign #1 data_o = data_i;
endmodule

module timescale_mismatch(input logic data_i, output logic data_o);
  timed_child child (.data_i(data_i), .data_o(data_o));
endmodule
```
